app.name: Gekko2 SPEED BETA12.25 GX TRIANGLES
app.long_description: Experimental GX source triangles with large textures, variable Z, CPU-side GS alpha/DATE/depth permissions and source cache. Retains full output size and bounded game diagnostics. Complex GS states still use software or hybrid paths. Chain residency and PSM conversion factory OFF; saved settings apply at Cold Boot. No confirmed Tekken gameplay, tile correction or Wii FPS gain. Use the separate control build for comparison. Bring your own legal BIOS/disc.
